newsitem.title: USA: NASD seeks comment on proposed shr pricing change.
newsitem.headline: NASD seeks comment on proposed shr pricing change.

text.p: The National Association of Securities Dealers Inc (NASD) said Tuesday it is requesting comment from investors, the securities industry, Nasdaq-listed companies and other interested parties on the impact of a change to decimal pricing of stock quotes from fractions.
The NASD said it will use the public and industry comments in its comprehensive study of decimal pricing.

"As part of our recent initiatives to protect investors, we are seeking input from all of our constituents," Frank Zarb, chairman, chief executive and president of the NASD said in a statement. "If the review demonstrates that decimal pricing aids investors in the purchase and sale of stocks, then we will do wahtever is necessary to make it happen."
NASD said it is asking those making comments to responsd to a series of questons. A list of questions is avaiable on the Web site www.investor.nasd.com.
Comments must be made by July 15, 1997.
